dogecoin.text:
Although Bellscoin was forgotten for nearly a decade as Dogecoin gained popularity, it was revived in 2023 and has started gaining attention in the crypto community.

Bellscoin is a unique project that combines fun and nostalgia within the crypto world.

Bellscoin (BELLS) was developed in 2013 by Billy Markus, one of the founders of Dogecoin, and was inspired by the “Bells” currency from the Animal Crossing game.

Launched eight days before Dogecoin, Bellscoin is actually considered the first meme coin. https://t.co/RzekkxuJ8E
